statements.text: This location was pivotal in America winning the Cold War, and it's poised to be pivotal in winning the technology race globally and driving the United States into the next 250 years of global leadership. The investment being made here is vital, from the most local level providing jobs to the neediest Ohioans, to the most international level of securing America's place on the world stage, which benefits all freedom-loving people around the world.
statements.venue: Remarks at groundbreaking of SB Energy/SoftBank AI data center and gas plant, Piketon, Ohio

statements.text: I am glad to see the $33 billion investment in this area move forward, and I want to thank the Federal Permitting Council and the Trump Administration for seeing the importance and potential of Southern Ohio.
statements.venue: Quoted in Permitting Council press release on PORTS Technology Campus (AI data center)

statements.text:
Today, @SenJonHusted, @RepMikeCarey, and I received a tour of @anduriltech from founder Palmer Luckey!

Developing autonomous defense systems like drones, aircraft, submarines, sensors, and AI-enabled command-and-control technology, @Anduril is creating thousands of jobs for skilled workers right in our own backyard.

It was great getting a behind the scenes tour of Arsenal-1 in Columbus and seeing firsthand the incredible economic impact that local defense manufacturing is making in our Buckeye state!

Our incredible @DHSgov agents work tirelessly every day to ensure our homeland is secure.

Yesterday I got to thank some of the agents (pups too!) for their dedication to keeping American families safe and addressing national threats, particularly as we solemnly approach the anniversary of 9/11. They demonstrated how their trained K9s can locate victims of crimes and the work they’re doing on the AI front to counter cybercrime and terrorism.

In Congress, I will always have the backs of our federal, state, and local law enforcement officers as they keep our country safe!

Ohio is rapidly emerging as a national hub for digital infrastructure, and Buckeye families should not have to bear rising energy costs resulting from local data center development. Today, I was proud to vote in support of the Ratepayer Protection Act to ensure data centers pay their fair share and shield consumers from soaring prices. Winning the AI race against adversaries like China should not come at the expense of Americans' pocketbooks, and I encourage local, state, and federal officials to continue working collaboratively to enhance transparency in the development process, establish Ohio as a national energy leader, and ensure our state remains an affordable place to live and raise a family for generations to come.
statements.venue: Press release on House passage of the Ratepayer Protection Act (H.R. 9340)

statements.text:
